verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office platform covering incorporation, compliance, accounting, tax and mail, so contract tracking is a plausible feature to ask about. The evidence shows no contract renewal, expiration, or obligation tracking with automatic alerts. The compliance dashboard's state filing deadlines (firstbase-docs-7) are a related but different feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can track contract renewals, expirations, and obligations with automatic alerts
